name: Smith Machine Seated Shoulder Press
steps: Place the bench so the bar can pass in front of your face, then sit tall with both feet flat.
Grip the bar just outside shoulder width, brace your trunk and release the hooks.
Lower the bar smoothly down toward your upper chest or chin level with your elbows slightly ahead of the bar.
Press the bar straight back overhead until your arms are extended without locking your elbows forcefully.
tips: Position the bench so the bar clears your nose cleanly without forcing you to lean far backward.
Keep your wrists stacked directly above your elbows throughout the press.
